title: A rendering isolated PHP quickstart is not refused because host probe roads are unavailable
steps: Make DNS and host port unavailable while the exact isolated site web container renders HTTP 200.
Repeat with a server error, wrong container identity and unsuccessful or malformed internal curl.
expect: Only a verified running web container for the exact compose project may supply fallback HTTP evidence.
Previously received 5xx is never hidden; unknown identity, failed exec and malformed HTTP remain refused.
evidence: Local pr1739-joomla57 provisioning failed despite internal and public HTTP 200; source fallback run inside tracy-host now returns 200.
fence: Fallback pins docker exec to an inspected full container ID and passes fixed curl arguments without a shell.

tests: an isolated PHP site is probed inside its verified running web container
an unverified container cannot supply health evidence
missing curl, failed exec and malformed HTTP output remain unavailable
